svg.text: LLMs as recognizers on the CLARA grids, by grid size: Accuracy
Each point is the mean over one grid size's evidence files; each LLM answered every file 3 times.
the stop rule scores exactly chance here
N − 1 goals on an N×N grid
the stop rule scores 1.0 at every size
N − 1 goals on an N×N grid
Each point averages 8–48 evidence files. Recognizers appear only at sizes where they answered every file. MC-SAT did so only on
SimpleGrid 3×3 and 4×4 and is left out. CLARA has no max-term records for ThreePackage or FourPackage. Intervals: results/clara/report.md.
